title: 2013 HMMT November Guts Problem 5
statement: How many positive integers less than 100 are relatively prime to 200? (Two numbers are relatively prime if their greatest common factor is 1 .)

solutions.text: \(401 \leq n<100\) is relatively prime to 200 if and only if it's relatively prime to 100 \(\left(200,100\right.\) have the same prime factors). Thus our answer is \(\phi(100)=100 \frac{1}{2} \frac{4}{5}=40\).
